info.description: The List Airline Flights Baggages API provides a comprehensive overview of baggage details for airline flights. It enables users to retrieve information about the baggage for specific flights, assisting travelers in managing their luggage expectations effectively. This API is essential for airline operations, customer service representatives, and travel applications that aim to deliver an enhanced travel experience. Developers can integrate this functionality into their platforms to allow passengers to easily access luggage information, thereby streamlining their travel journey.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details regarding baggage associated with various flights, including dimensions, weight limits, and any additional requirements or restrictions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains information related to baggage for flights. It allows clients to specify details about the baggage they are inquiring about or managing.
